title: Continuous Sweep Backdrop Roll
description: One original fixed partly unrolled studio backdrop visual prop. A single closed 10 mm thick stylized sheet makes four real separated spiral turns around a solid core, continues down the front, curves smoothly onto a finite floor tail, and stays visibly clear of two independent upright supports. The transverse shaft is captured by two thick bored fixed-interference seats, each supported by a post and a broad finite ground foot. Actual sheet-edge surfaces, inter-layer gaps, support joints and ground faces are measurable geometry, not texture lines. One complete assembly counts as one prop. Separate editable closed meshes, four solid PBR materials, no textures, cameras, lights, people or scene; metres, Z up, ground design datum at X midline and Y=0; the datum is not the bounding-box centre. Only one static display pose is checked. No winding or unwinding animation, textile or paper physics, tension, anti-tip stability, load bearing, standard dimensions, installation, safety certification, photographic color accuracy, optical performance or compatibility with previous camera or lighting assets is claimed.
